## The request

What would Sara ask Firstmate?

## What happens today

Which teammate gets it, or does Firstmate handle it? Which file says so?

## What should happen

Who should own it, and what should Firstmate verify before reporting done?

## Why

What went wrong, or what will this make easier? Leave out secrets and private IDs.
